text_block_list.text:
One day, with the Arima Kinen just around the corner,
Mayano Top Gun called me out.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Trainer-chan, hurry, hurry~☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Look, look, look☆ There's a snowman over here,
and a Christmas tree over there too♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Yup♪ Because today is a special date, after all!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: A holy night for lovers... or something like that~☆
Besides, today—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Nihihi, I get it already~

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
It's not Christmas Day yet,
nor is it nighttime... but, you know.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: That's precisely why I thought I'd go ahead and make a "reservation"!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah! Honestly I wanna go on a date on Christmas Eve,
...but you've got important plans that day, right?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: And with that... Trainer-chan!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Take a photo of Maya, take one!☆
With Trainer-chan's phone!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Are you ready-y?
You can't miss this photo op-!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Three, two, ooone...
(*Snap*)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, did it turn out cute~?
You'd better take good care of that photo!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I'll give you that pose as a present
on the real holy night!
Hearing that, I checked the image, and—

On screen, Mayano Top Gun was waving
enthusiastically with a big smile.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ahem! ☆ In Arima,
Maya's only aiming for 1st place!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: For this year's Christmas, I'll give Trainer-chan the gift of the most radiant me possible!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: So Trainer-chan, give Maya all your plans for Christmas Eve!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: —In my Arima Kinen!!

—Seeing her make that declaration,
it made me look forward to this year's Arima Kinen
all the more.

...On the screen was Mayano Top Gun,
blowing a kiss right at the camera.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Nihihi, look forward to this Christmas Eve...
and the concert after the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya will definitely stand in the center
and blow a kiss just for you☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, it's okay, totally okay~☆
I'll make sure nobody else notices!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Nihihi... Feels totally like an adult relationship, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, it's totally fine, totally fine! ☆
I'll do it secretly when the stage goes dark!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
T-h-a-t-'s why~☆ During the Arima Kinen live concert,
keep your eyes glued on Maya at center stage♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Or maybe... Trainer-chan,
would you rather get a "smooch"
after I step off the stage~?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: "...Maya's fine with that too, though! Eheh☆"

...With that, I firmly instructed Mayano Top Gun
not to add any unapproved choreography.
However, this year's Arima Kinen was—

Mayano Top Gun will surely take 1st place,
...and stand at the center for us.
